name: @payswap/app
description: The PaySwap product application surface (Work Order P9-A): the presentational, platform-agnostic PaySwap product experience — home, app shell over the pinned eleven-area navigation IA, capabilities/coverage, security and developers surfaces — consumed by the web mount (@zcode/web) and the desktop renderer (@zcode/desktop). PRESENTATIONAL with injected platform/data adapters: no fetch, no ambient window/session state; every view is a projection of its explicit inputs (INV-23), honest by construction (UNKNOWN renders as UNKNOWN; unavailable surfaces state their typed prerequisites; nothing fabricates success).
